svg.aria-label: One image, two deployments: the management / data-plane split
svg.title: One image, two deployments: the management / data-plane split
svg.text: One image, two deployments: the management / data-plane split

Production agent calls no longer share a backend with the console · the entry service mounts only the service API — management code paths are absent, not just gated · lock down or stop the console and channel invocations keep flowing
the console side can be IP-restricted, access-windowed, or stopped entirely — production traffic never notices
both deployments read the same registry, sessions and ledger (DynamoDB) —
what differs is which routes exist, not which data they see
management · people running the console & workbench
The split is subtractive, not additive: PLATFORM_ENTRY_ONLY=1 skips mounting every management router, middleware and scheduler — a console vulnerability has no code path into production calls.

Each side scales and hardens on its own: the entry service carries no portal session, no user auth and no workbench, while the console can adopt internal-only network rules without touching the SLA of a single channel.
✗ every route here requires user OIDC — no machine path
